snippet.title: Occult Office: Lofi Rituals - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Occult Office: Lofi Rituals is a cozy virtual office game that blends lo-fi vibes, magical rituals, and real-life productivity tools.

Wishlist Occult Office: Lofi Rituals on Steam. Thank you!

Grab your coffee and immerse yourself in this gorgeous, pixel-art, supernatural workplace that you can customize as you wish. Start your day with your favorite lo-fi beats and open your planner. Organize your tasks for a day or the whole lunar cycle, then cast a pomodoro spell to keep your focus sharp.

When it’s time for a break, skip the doomscrolling. Instead, nurture your greenhouse of esoteric plants, or descend into the office dungeon to battle elder creatures. Along the way, meet your companions, cute, creepy, or utterly magical pets who lend a hand in your daily rituals.

Occult Office aims to make productivity playful and meaningful for everyone, including those who struggle with focus or self-organization. Customize your rituals in a skill tree, grow your workspace, and find your rhythm.

Everything is possible because in your occult office, you’re the boss.
